description: Route a generic project manifest request to its existing tuple manifest
expression: ( http.host eq "expo-ota.byulmaru.co" and http.request.method eq "GET" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/releases/") and substring(http.request.uri.path, 10) ne "" and substring(http.request.uri.path, 10) ne "." and substring(http.request.uri.path, 10) ne ".." and not (substring(http.request.uri.path, 10) contains "/") and not (substring(http.request.uri.path, 10) contains "\\") and not (substring(http.request.uri.path, 10) contains "?") and not (substring(http.request.uri.path, 10) contains "#") and not (substring(http.request.uri.path, 10) contains "%") and http.request.headers["expo-protocol-version"][0] eq "1" and (http.request.headers["expo-platform"][0] eq "ios" or http.request.headers["expo-platform"][0] eq "android") and http.request.headers["expo-channel-name"][0] ne "" and http.request.headers["expo-channel-name"][0] ne "." and http.request.headers["expo-channel-name"][0] ne ".." and not (http.request.headers["expo-channel-name"][0] contains "/") and not (http.request.headers["expo-channel-name"][0] contains "\\") and not (http.request.headers["expo-channel-name"][0] contains "?") and not (http.request.headers["expo-channel-name"][0] contains "#") and not (http.request.headers["expo-channel-name"][0] contains "%") and http.request.headers["expo-runtime-version"][0] ne "" and http.request.headers["expo-runtime-version"][0] ne "." and http.request.headers["expo-runtime-version"][0] ne ".." and not (http.request.headers["expo-runtime-version"][0] contains "/") and not (http.request.headers["expo-runtime-version"][0] contains "\\") and not (http.request.headers["expo-runtime-version"][0] contains "?") and not (http.request.headers["expo-runtime-version"][0] contains "#") and not (http.request.headers["expo-runtime-version"][0] contains "%") )
